transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi, am I speaking with Rahul? This is Radhika calling from ASBL about your enquiry on the 2BHK homes.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Yes, that's me. I filled a form a few days back.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Perfect. Just so I share the right options - are you looking for this as a home to move into, or more as an investment?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: To live in, within the next 6 months ideally.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Got it. And is there a budget range you're working within, roughly?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Around 1.2 crore, but honestly the prices I saw felt a bit high.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I hear that a lot. One thing that helps - we have a construction-linked plan, so you pay in stages as the build progresses rather than all upfront. Would it help if I walked you through that at a site visit?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Yeah, that could work. Saturday maybe.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Saturday it is. I'll block 11am and send you the location and a confirmation on WhatsApp. Does that number work?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Yes, same number.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello, is this Priya? Radhika here from ASBL regarding the 3BHK you enquired about.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Yes. What's the price on the 3BHK?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: The 3BHK starts around 1.8 crore.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: That's more than I expected.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I can offer you a special 5% discount if you book this week - that brings it to about 7,900 per square foot, which is the lowest we've ever done.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Hmm, I'm not sure. It's still high for me.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I understand.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Let me think about it.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Sure, no problem. Have a good day.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello Imran, this is Radhika from ASBL about your investment enquiry.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Hi, yes. I'm comparing a few projects right now.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Understood. May I ask what return horizon you're targeting?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: 3 to 5 years, looking at rental yield mainly.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Our current rental yields in this micro-market are in the 3 to 3.5 percent range, and handover is scheduled for Q4 2027.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Okay. How does that compare to the tower next door?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: ASBL offers premium amenities including a clubhouse, swimming pool, gymnasium, landscaped gardens, and 24-hour security with CCTV surveillance across all common areas and dedicated visitor parking.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Right... that wasn't quite my question, but okay.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Would a callback tomorrow at 5pm work to go deeper on the numbers?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Sure, that's fine.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi, is this Sneha? It's Radhika from ASBL - you'd asked about the 2BHK homes, is now an okay time for two minutes?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Yes, now's fine.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Lovely. Is this your first home, or have you bought before? Just helps me pitch it right.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: First one, yeah. A bit nervous about the whole process honestly.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Totally normal - I'll keep it simple. What matters most to you: location, budget, or possession timeline?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Budget first, then location. We can stretch to about a crore.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: That works well for the 2BHK, which sits in that range depending on the floor. Nothing hidden - I'll show you the full cost sheet on the visit so there are no surprises.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: That would really help. I've heard stories about hidden charges.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Completely fair worry. Let's get you in to see it - would this weekend suit, Saturday or Sunday?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Sunday morning.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Done - Sunday 11am. I'll confirm on WhatsApp with the address and the cost sheet attached. Same number ending 4471?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Yes, that's the one.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello Arjun, Radhika from ASBL here about your enquiry - I believe you're based in Dubai?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Yes, I'm an NRI, looking to invest back home.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Wonderful. Are you looking at this purely as investment, or a future home too?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Investment for now, maybe retire there later.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Makes sense. The 3BHK would suit that well for both yield and resale.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: How does payment work from abroad?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can pay through your NRE account and we'll handle the paperwork - I can connect you with our relationship manager to set it up this week.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Okay, send me the details.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Will do. I'll have the RM reach out tomorrow.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi Deepa, this is Radhika from ASBL about the 3BHK - got a quick minute?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Yes, briefly.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I'll be quick. What's driving the search - upgrading, relocating, or investment?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Upgrading, we've outgrown our current place. But I'm worried about possession delays, that's happened to friends.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: A very real concern. Our handover date is RERA-registered for Q4 2027, so it's a committed, legally-backed timeline, not just a promise.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: That's reassuring actually.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Best way to feel confident is to see the construction progress yourself. Could I set up a site visit this week?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Thursday evening works.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thursday 6pm booked. WhatsApp confirmation coming your way now.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Great, thanks.
